## What changed

One change: a skill, a fix or a change to the spec.

## Why

The reason, in a sentence or two. If it makes a design choice, the DECISIONS.md entry it adds.

## How it was checked

- [ ] `pnpm -r test` passes
- [ ] `pnpm -r build` leaves every `dist/` unchanged
- [ ] Examples use the coffee shop; nothing real or private
- [ ] The house style: no em dashes, no emojis, no comma before a joining word such as "and" or "but"
